description: Navigate your life journey across dimensions privately Payanam (பயணம் — "journey") is a privacy-first life dimension manager for Android. Track what matters to you across the dimensions of life you define. Your data stays on your device by default. You control what leaves it. No cloud of ours. No accounts. No tracking. No subscriptions. Payanam has no servers of its own. Life Dimensions Comes with 9 default dimensions — Work & Livelihood, Physical Health, Family & Relationships, Home Environment, Money & Finance, Mental Health, Recreation & Leisure, Learning & Growth, Community & Service. Customize names, icons, colors, or create your own. Set per-dimension weightage that controls how each life area contributes to your scores. Habits — The Core The most mature module. Habits are recurring tasks with frequency-aware scheduling (daily, weekly, or X times per Y days). Every completion cascades through a 3-level metric system — habit-level (score, streaks, progress) → dimension-level (weighted average with carry-forward) → day-level aggregate. Dedicated habits insights include a score matrix (6 metrics, 14-day sparklines, rankings) and a dimension-spread radar chart comparing today's scores against your running average. Tasks Full CRUD with a 6-factor priority scoring engine (dimension importance, impact, goal alignment, energy, control, duration) — all configurable weights. Set due dates, tags, reminders, recurrence, and track occurrence history. Stopping time tracking auto-completes the linked task. Time Tracking Per-dimension time blocks with focus rating (0.0–1.0). Manual sessions: pick a dimension, start, stop. Habit auto-track: completing a habit auto-creates a time entry (opt-in per dimension, 15-min default). Both paths write to the same time store — there's no separate "habit time" vs "task time." Day-plan allocations let you set planned minutes per dimension; a Gaussian model scores how well actual time matches your plan. Journal Two levels per day: overall day reflection + per-dimension prompts. Both independently fillable each day. Insights & Lenses Opt-in by design — pick and enable exactly which charts you want (score cards, trends, heatmaps, radar, splits, timelines). Lenses build planning-vs-reality snapshots from time entries, task occurrences, and day-plan allocations. Five reflection card types detect untracked time, missed tasks, missed habits, focus gaps, and dimension gaps. Some chart metrics are still evolving — marked as pending in-app. Day Planning Template-based with auto/custom modes. Set planned minutes per dimension, with weekday/weekend preferences. Feeds time-deviation scoring and Lenses. Scoring Configuration Fine-grained control: adjust 6 cross-task factor weights plus per-level values for impact, goal alignment, energy, and control. Your priorities, your formula. Security & Backup Encrypted by default — set a strong passphrase (12+ chars, upper/lower/digit/symbol) on first launch. Optional biometric unlock with configurable auto-lock timeout (1 min to 4 hours). Auto-backup on configurable intervals (15 min to 24 hours) with rotation. Manual encrypted export/import with passphrase. Export logs from settings or the unlock screen. Customization Enable or disable individual modules. Choose your default home tab. System theme with Material You dynamic colors. English and Tamil locale support. Font family customization (sans, serif, monospace, cursive). Cross-Platform & Updates Android is in good shape. Windows desktop in early development. Linux and other platforms planned. Goal: fully featured cross-platform apps with same data, features, and privacy. GitHub builds include an in-app update checker (dev/beta/stable, opt-in). The F-Droid build has no in-app updates — update through your F-Droid client. For in-app updates, install from GitHub releases. Payanam is open source under AGPL-3.0. No ads. No analytics. No dark patterns. Just your journey.
